hypothesis:
On IBKR TSM 15-minute RTH bars, a completed-bar SMA5 crossing above SMA20 identifies short-horizon up-moves that continue long enough to earn a positive net return per round trip AFTER costs and BEYOND TSM's unconditional upward drift over the same holding time, consistently across the 2017-2024 development years.
Hypothesis: Pre-registered success requires ALL of: (1) >= 30 valid round trips; (2) BASE and STRESS net expectancy > 0 and STRESS profit factor > 1; (3) DRIFT-MATCHED-v1 mean excess per trade > 0 under BASE (descriptive excess over the in-sample drift baseline); (4) net PnL > 0 in at least 5 of the 8 calendar years and in both halves 2017-2020 and 2021-2024; (5) no single calendar year provides more than 50% of total net PnL. Any failure = hypothesis not supported on Development data.
Null: SMA5/20 net performance does not exceed the deterministic in-sample unconditional-drift baseline for the same holding durations (DRIFT-MATCHED-v1 mean excess <= 0), or net expectancy <= 0 after BASE/STRESS costs.
market_mechanism: Information about TSM reaches the US ADR gradually: Taiwan-session news and semiconductor-sector flows are absorbed by US participants over hours, and large holders split orders over the session. Gradual incorporation creates short-horizon positive autocorrelation of 15m returns; the counterparties are liquidity providers and slower participants who trade against the move. Long-only by construction.
